features: 23.8" FULL HD IPS DISPLAY: 1920 x 1080 resolution with 178° wide viewing angles, 99% sRGB coverage and 16.7 million colors for crisp, accurate visuals. The anti-glare screen cuts reflections for work, streaming and gaming
144Hz REFRESH RATE & 1ms MPRT: Get smooth, fluid motion with reduced blur in games and fast-moving video. Response time modes run from 6ms (Normal) to 4ms (Extreme) GTG.

AMD FreeSync SUPPORT: Syncs the monitor with compatible AMD Radeon graphics cards to reduce screen tearing and stutter. 1500:1 contrast and 250 nits brightness add depth and detail to everyday content.
BUILT-IN 2 x 3W SPEAKERS: Enjoy audio straight from the monitor with no extra desk clutter. Connect through HDMI or VGA, with an audio-out port for headphones or external speakers.

EYE COMFORT & SLIM DESIGN: Hardware Low Blue Light and TÜV-certified Flicker Free technology for long viewing sessions. The ultra-thin, four-sided narrow bezel design in Cloud Grey suits multi-monitor setups. The tilt stand (-5° to +22°) has a built-in phone holder and cable management, and the monitor is VESA 100 x 100 compatible.
Included components: Monitor with stand, 1x HDMI 1.4 cable (1.8m), 1x Power cable (1.8m), 1x Screw, Quick setup guide, Warranty booklet

Excellent screen performance: Experience stunning clarity on a 23.8-inch FHD display featuring a 144Hz refresh rate, 99% sRGB color accuracy, and a 1500:1 contrast ratio—delivering smooth, vivid, and true-to-life visuals
Enhanced Eye Care: Work or play comfortably for longer with built-in low blue light hardware and TÜVcertified flicker-free technology, designed to reduce eye strain and fatigue
Immersive sound: Enjoy immersive sound from the monitor’s integrated dual 3W speakers
Virtually borderless viewing: With ultra-thin bezels on all four sides, the display blends effortlessly into your space, drawing your attention to what matters most—the screen
